verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the platform supports document verification with country/type filtering (passports, national IDs implied via document report configuration) and dashboard-level configuration of accepted documents by issuing country and type, but no evidence pack item actually publishes a concrete supported list of countries or enumerates document types beyond generic references. Missing for 10: an explicit published breadth list (countries covered, document types like driver licenses/residence permits enumerated) and independent verification of coverage claims.
